description: Mortal Champions: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Killing one Qiraji lord is a notable accomplishment for a mortal, friend. They are however, numerous and powerful. Continue to defeat them to prove your worth as our champion.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You continue to serve us well, friend. Our pact remains in place.
